study_identification_part.si_4_title: Brain-Charting Autism and Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder Reveals Distinct and Overlapping Neurobiology

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Unknown covers POND, UK MRC-AIMS, and UCSD Biomarkers of Autism datasets not listed in the guide; the study also used pre-trained BrainChart reference models (75,241 TD).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: T1-weighted scans were combined from 49 sites across 7 datasets, including the ABIDE (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange) (102,103), the POND (Province of Ontario Neurodevelopmental) Network, the HBN (Healthy Brain Network) at the Child Mind Institute (104), the ADHD200 Consortium, the Multimodal Developmental Neurogenetics of Females with ASD dataset from the National Institute of Mental Health Data Archive, the UK MRC-AIMS (Medical Research Council Autism Imaging Multi-centre Study), and the University of California San Diego Biomarkers of Autism study. Our previous work (98) generated reference models using generalized additive models of location scale and shape to map neuroanatomical developmental trajectories across the life span, using a sample of 75,241 TD individuals
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: Sample and Datasets; Bedford2025.pdf.md: Generation of Centile Scores Using Generalized Additive Models of Location Scale and Shape
